<NAME>
probe_and_reciprocate
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Opens cooperatively to establish mutual cooperation, reciprocates defections, and periodically tests consistently cooperative opponents. If a test is not punished, it exploits that opponent; if punished, it immediately returns to cooperation.
</DESCRIPTION>

    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else (1 if opponent_history[-1] == 1 else (1 if len(opponent_history) % 32 == 0 else 0))
